integrity: A complete proof and standalone finite enumeration are included. The proof is an internal mathematical check; no independent review or verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only weight-one K-linear operators on one-generator truncated polynomial algebras over fields of characteristic two are classified. The general result follows from proof, not finite enumeration; related literature may contain an earlier equivalent theorem.
title: Four weight-one Rota–Baxter operators on characteristic-two truncated polynomial chains
